title: Conditional κ = 0.00308520 (+3.31e-6 over #5580): P104 commuting-contact cascade
body:
## Summary

This package (`research/p104-commuting-contact/`) resolves the open reordered-contact question of [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) (`research/p104-event-contact-step`) on the P104 word and certifies **conditional κ = 0.00308520** (tested at `0.0030852005`), up from `0.00308189` in [PR #5580](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5580) and `0.00308181` in [PR #5569](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5569).

- **Headline word (`WORD.json.gz`, Stage A + Stage B):** Exact raw crossing lies in **`(0.00308521055201, 0.00308521055202)`**, a raw gain of **`+3.31558334e-6 to +3.31558336e-6`** over PR #5580's `(0.00308189496866, 0.00308189496867)`. Complete paid calls drop by **126** (`66,852 -> 66,726`), while all 208 main endpoints, 12,814 productive fields, rank-mass surplus `760`, and all eight owned lifetimes remain unchanged.
- **Fixed-endpoint supporting word (`WORD-FIXED-ENDPOINTS.json.gz`, Stage A only):** Retains **all 735 `initial` and `final` frames and all 527 helper targets** identical to PR #5580 (`local['helpers'] == parent_local['helpers']`), reducing complete paid calls by **72** (`66,852 -> 66,780`) with local paid delta `-4 H1 - 4 H4 + 4 H5` and raising the raw crossing to **`(0.00308415555080, 0.00308415555081)`** (`+2.26058214e-6` over PR #5580, certifying **κ = 0.00308415**).

[Proof](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/PROOF.md) · [Complete receipt](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/RESULT.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/SOURCES.json) · [Construction](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/construct.py) · [Validation](https://github.com/hexapode/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9af814164b9dfc21f19ec737959d67cb71488c95/research/p104-commuting-contact/VALIDATION.md)

---

## Mathematical Mechanism

PR #5561, PR #5569, and PR #5580 kept the linear execution order of the 21,686 scalar operations from PR #5551 fixed. In that fixed order, early moves of main ports `113` and `198` from `3` (`0D`) to `597` (`[82]`, `1D`) at events `13524` and `13528` (to read helper `710`) trapped subsequent commuting `ADD` writes into `198` and `113` at chart `597`:

1. **Stage A (`WORD-FIXED-ENDPOINTS.json.gz`, fixed helper endpoints, `-4 H1 - 4 H4 + 4 H5` locally):**
   - Between `13528` and `13634`, main port `198` receives only `ADD` writes (`13529: ADD 198, 710, 2` and `13625, 13628, 13631, 13634: ADD 198, 648/649/650/652, ±1/2`), and helpers `648, 649, 650, 652` are in their initial read-only epoch at chart `3` (`0D`).
   - Commuting `13625, 13628, 13631, 13634` before `13528: ['MOVE', 198, 3, 597, False]` to chart `3` (`0D`) vacates chart `597` (`1D`) on all four helpers `648, 649, 650, 652`, collapsing each itinerary `3 (0D) -> 597 (1D) -> 120 (5D)` (`H1 + H4`) into a single direct transport `3 (0D) -> 120 (5D)` (`H5`).
2. **Stage B (`WORD.json.gz`, domino cascade on `113, 531, 197, 319, 507`, `-4 H1 - H3 + 2 H4` paid and `-H8 + H9` target locally):**
   - Commuting `13806: ['ADD', 113, 531, '1']` before `13524: ['MOVE', 113, 3, 597, False]` to chart `3` (`0D`) allows all three initial read contacts of helper `531` (`13806` with `113`, `13843` with `197`, and `14404` with `507`) to execute at chart `3` (`0D`) with `initial[531] = 3`.
   - Because `197` stays at `3` (`0D`) after `13843` instead of climbing to `597` (`[82]`), its next contact `13846: ['ADD', 197, 319, '1']` demotes from 3-plane `617` (`[30, 44, 76]`) to 2-plane `355` (`[30, 44]`), vacating `617` on both `197` (`3 -> 355 -> 788`, `H2 + H3` instead of `H1 + 2 H2`) and `319` (`355 -> 728`, `H2` instead of `2 H1`), while `507` climbs directly `3 -> 728` (`H4` instead of `H1 + H3`) and `531` climbs `3 -> 741` (`H4` instead of `H3`, with helper credit `H8 -> H9`).

| Word | Paid calls | Local paid delta vs #5580 | Local target delta | Raw crossing interval | Claimed κ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PR #5580 (`p104-event-contact-step`) | `66,852` | baseline | baseline | `(0.00308189496866, 0.00308189496867)` | `0.00308189` |
| Stage A (`WORD-FIXED-ENDPOINTS.json.gz`) | `66,780` | `-4 H1 - 4 H4 + 4 H5` | `0` (all 735 endpoints fixed) | `(0.00308415555080, 0.00308415555081)` | `0.00308415` |
| Stage A+B (`WORD.json.gz`, headline) | `66,726` | `-8 H1 - H3 - 2 H4 + 4 H5` | `-H8 + H9` (`initial[531]: 597 -> 3`) | `(0.00308521055201, 0.00308521055202)` | **`0.00308520`** |

---

## Verification

Standard-library Python 3.10+ suffices; no external solver is required:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-commuting-contact
```

Expected markers are `PASS_P104_COMMUTING_CONTACT_KAPPA_00308520` in both normal and `-O` modes and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.
